name: forge
description: Sequential build pipeline — plan → design → code → test → review → security → deploy — with auto-routed Fable 5 (plan, design, review), Opus 4.8 (security), and Sonnet 5 (code, test, deploy) models per phase, each at tuned reasoning effort. The design phase renders a mockup of every UI surface (HTML/CSS, or real shadcn/ui code when the stack fits) for human approval before coding.
